name: Tainted Parchment
summary: A marked parchment waits for you after your absence, and your teacher Nartok asks to speak with you. Its words challenge Thrall’s rule and warn of the dangers warlocks face.

sections.title: A message waits
sections.body: The marked parchment is believed to come from Nartok, your new teacher. Read it, then speak with him in the Den in the Valley of Trials. He calls the orcs a proud people and says Thrall turns away from power that could make the land theirs.

sections.title: A place among them
sections.body: Nartok says you have joined their ranks, yet warlock power will not make you welcome. Thrall allows warlocks into Orgrimmar because they remain orcs. Nartok warns that recklessness can be fatal. He remains ready to teach you spellcasting if you need instruction.

faq.answer: The parchment is believed to come from Nartok, your new teacher.

faq.q: Where can I speak with Nartok?
faq.answer: Nartok is in the Den in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: What does Nartok think of Thrall?
faq.answer: Nartok says Thrall turns away from power that could make the land theirs.

faq.q: Why does Thrall allow warlocks into Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Nartok says Thrall allows warlocks into Orgrimmar because they are still orcs.
Nartok warns that warlock power does not ensure acceptance, and recklessness can be fatal.
Nartok remains available if you need instruction in spellcasting.

angles.text: As a warlock, you face the danger Nartok warns of: wielding your power recklessly may prove fatal.
